locator.final_shipping_correction: Footnote 7, referenced from Lowlevel Texture Painting

sources.paraphrase: Creature edits require rapid atlas creation for immediate Play/Paint Mode. The charter floods adjacent similarly facing triangles, projects to cardinal planes and packs charts. Prototype brushes collect affected triangles and splat in 3D brush coordinates; particles used barycentric surface coordinates. Henry replaced the Swarm hookup with morphology-aware, limb-relative control and ported painting into the background game engine. Footnote 7 corrects the shipping version: skirts were disabled for speed; dilation remained, with editor seams disappearing after painting completes.
history_split: Mouse/tablet painting, skirt polygons and the initial Swarm plugin describe prototypes.
The custom morphology system and shipping dilation correction must not be merged with those prototype mechanisms.

questions.question: Does widening, lengthening or adding parts rerun paint or reproject persistent particles?
questions.established: Rapid atlas creation after mesh editing is described; dynamic surface painting exists.
questions.boundary: No explicit edit-trigger matrix, repaint/reprojection choice, persistent walker identity, dirty-region algorithm or cached-texture invalidation rule found in the selected complete text.

questions.question: How do stripe/spot direction and scale follow morphology?
questions.established: Spine/limb-relative motion, skeleton-influenced frames and oriented strokes are described.
questions.boundary: No exact stripe spacing, spot count, world-scale versus normalized-scale policy, brush radius formula or deterministic seed transition supplied.

questions.question: Do the body and attached rigblocks share a continuous pattern?
questions.established: The paper names body mesh plus attached detail parts and mesh-surface brushes.
questions.boundary: It does not establish one continuous field across separately attached parts, a shared atlas for all details or part-boundary pattern correspondence.

questions.question: Which seams are addressed?
questions.established: Texture chart seams and filtering are addressed; shipping correction uses dilation after painting.
questions.boundary: Dilation is texture-sampling protection, not evidence of geometric attachment welding or continuity between independent body/part paint fields.
